sources: Beacon of Duty (6-star polearm; needs Heat Inflictions and Heat Susceptibility: Camille is the only Heat polearm operator). Skill 3 sk_wpn_lance_0007 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; SkillPatchTable L1–L9 fire_dmg_up 0.07–0.196, dmg_up 0.08–0.224 for duration 20 s, dmg_up2 0.04–0.112 for duration2 30 s; the file's own blackboard defaults are template values the table overrides): cardAttributeModifier attribute 51 (Heat DMG) +fire_dmg_up is a stat-panel line, as are skills 1–2 (Agility, Ultimate Gain Efficiency).

abilityEvent 126 (OnCharBeforeOutputSpellInfliction) + CheckOriginSkillType [2, 6, 7] (battle, combo, ultimate) + CheckSpellInflictionType mask 1 (Heat) → buff_wpn_lance_0007_dmgup on the wielder (targetSource 1): Physical and Heat DMG (attributes 50, 51) +dmg_up for duration. Before the inflicting hit's damage, as Lustrous Carmine's and Solemn Phalanx's handler on the same event (40d9 / 4e5e show it for Lustrous Carmine). An infliction that forms a reaction counts: the kit counts it since 2026-10-22 (`reactions: true`, the owner's reading; abilityEvent 126 fires before the game resolves the infliction; in-game test 35 can still confirm).

abilityEvent 206 (OnBeforeOutputBuff: the wielder applies a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1, tag 458037917 (Heat Susceptibility: on buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_fire, _spell and _all) + CheckOriginSkillType [6, 7, 2] → buff_wpn_lance_0007_dmgup2 on CharacterTeamFinder (the whole team, wielder included): Physical and Heat DMG +dmg_up2 for duration2. The tag maps to the buffApplied filter categories [susceptibility], elements [fire] (an Arts or all-element Susceptibility counts; batch-4 T1). Like the event, it acts before the applying hit's damage when the buff does (Camille's Vesperwings: beforeDamage).

Both buffs stackingType 4 with priority key pd_up and maxStackCntKey max_stack (keys the weapon doesn't have): one instance, a reapplication refreshes; two wielders' team buffs adding is batch-4 B2's open part. Its toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (atk_up, a key the skill doesn't have) is a template leftover with no effect, as Twilight's. buff_wpn_lance_0007 and _atk_up are referenced by no skill file. Not in any log yet.
